reasons.raw-palette-class: roadmap §5 — the generated 49 CFR §391.23 document is rasterised by html2canvas into a bare print window with no --ds-* custom properties, so a token would resolve to nothing. VOEPreviewModal.export.test.jsx enforces the boundary in both directions.

reasons.arbitrary-type-size: roadmap §5 — the 13px release-authorisation paragraph inside the generated 49 CFR §391.23 document. Same immutable export as this file's other entries: html2canvas rasterises it into a bare print window with no --ds-* properties, and VOEPreviewModal.export.test.jsx fails if the document acquires a token.

reasons.hand-built-overlay: A pointer-events-none spotlight, not a dialog. It has no dialog semantics because it is not one: it never traps focus and never blocks the page.

reasons.hand-styled-anchor: A status-tinted phone chip that is also a tel: link. Fully tokenised with a screen-reader prefix ("Call now:"). Neither Link (underlined text) nor ButtonLink (button-shaped) is a tinted inline chip. See the tinted-chip-link gap in §5.

reasons.hand-styled-button: A selectable company row, not a button. It is correctly a <button> (it is a real activation), uses only --ds-* tokens and the shared focus ring. The rule cannot distinguish a tokenised selectable row from a hand-built button; forcing it into Button would make a list row look like an action bar.

reasons.hand-styled-field: Two inline numeric goal editors inside a labelled chip. Both are already tokenised, carry an aria-label and aria-invalid, and use the shared focus ring. `Input` is a 44px bordered full-width control and would destroy the compact inline chip; overriding it back would be worse than this. See the inline-editable-value gap in §5.

reasons.raw-hex-colour: A print stylesheet, injected as a string into a bare print window that has no --ds-* custom properties — the same class of exception as the VOE export document. A token here would resolve to nothing and the page would print with no background.
